rows.q: 4G keeps saying connected but nothing loads
rows.answer:
1. Make sure your phone is set to 4G/LTE: Settings > Mobile Network > Preferred Network Type, select 4G/LTE.
2. Reset your APN settings: toggle airplane mode on, then off, and re-enable mobile data.
3. If the issue continues, contact support so they can enable carrier aggregation on your profile.
4. If you still cannot access data, an agent will need to review your account and network status.

rows.q: how do I share my phone's internet with my laptop
rows.answer: To share your phone’s internet with your laptop you can use the mobile hotspot feature. 1. Navigate to Settings > Mobile Network > APN and verify the APN name, username, and password match the carrier's published settings. 2. Enable the hotspot on your phone (the exact menu path is not listed in the sources). 3. On your laptop, connect to the hotspot SSID using the password shown on your phone. 4. If you run out of hotspot data, consider adding the Hotspot Boost add-on for an extra 15 GB of high-speed data per month (no contract).

rows.q: what are premium SMS charges on my bill
rows.answer: Premium SMS charges appear when you subscribe to a third-party service that uses Direct Carrier Billing. These are listed as individual items on your itemised bill. You can view each charge in the app under Billing > Itemised Bill, which shows the date, time and cost of every premium SMS. If you did not intend to subscribe, you may need to contact support for a review.

rows.q: how far back can I download old bills
rows.answer: You can download bills for the last 12 months from the portal.

rows.q: will I get a reminder before autopay takes money
rows.answer: Yes. If you have AutoPay enabled, you will receive an SMS reminder 3 days before each payment is taken.

rows.q: I lost my phone and SIM yesterday, how do I block it
rows.answer: Call 611 right away to have your SIM blocked. Then visit any store with a valid photo ID to get a replacement SIM. A $5 fee applies and your number and plan will transfer automatically.

rows.q: new sim still not working after an hour
rows.answer: A new SIM usually activates within 15 minutes. If it hasn’t activated after 1 hour, restart your phone. If it’s still inactive, call 611 and give them the SIM serial number printed on the card.

rows.q: is an eSIM different from a normal SIM card
rows.answer: An eSIM is a chip built into the device that can be reprogrammed over the air, whereas a normal SIM is a removable card you insert into the phone. The eSIM can hold multiple profiles and lets you switch carriers without swapping cards. A physical SIM is a separate card that you physically insert.

rows.q: my phone is locked to your network, can I use another carrier's sim
rows.answer: Your phone is currently locked to NovaCell. It can only be used with a NovaCell SIM until it is unlocked. Phones become unlocked after 60 days from purchase or once the device is fully paid off. To unlock, submit a request via MyTelecom > Device > Request Unlock or call 611. Unlocking is free of charge.

rows.q: how much is the monthly international pass and what does it include
rows.answer: The NovaCell International Monthly Pass costs $50 per month per line. It gives you 15 GB of high-speed data while abroad, unlimited international talk and text, and coverage in 210+ countries. The pass has no contract and renews automatically until you cancel.

rows.q: landed in Singapore and have no service at all
rows.answer: It looks like you may not have international roaming enabled for Singapore. Singapore is in Zone B, so you’ll need to activate roaming before you can use data, voice or SMS. You can turn it on in the MyTelecom app under Plan & Services > International Roaming, or call 611 to enable it. Once activated, the network will update in up to 15 minutes. If you still see no service after that, let an agent know so they can check your roaming permissions and add the appropriate zone.

rows.q: does roaming turn itself off when I get home
rows.answer: Roaming is automatically disabled when you return home.

rows.q: people say my voice sounds bad and robotic, what is HD voice
rows.answer: HD voice is the high-definition voice quality that VoLTE delivers. It uses wide-band audio at 16 kHz instead of the 3.4 kHz of legacy calls, giving clearer, more natural sound. VoLTE also sets priority for voice packets so they aren’t affected by data traffic, reducing distortion and robotic-like quality.

rows.q: no signal inside my flat, can I still make calls
rows.answer: If you have no cellular signal inside your flat you can still make calls using Wi-Fi calling, provided your plan includes the feature and it is enabled on your account. Enable it by going to Settings > Phone > Wi-Fi Calling and toggling it on. If you’re not sure whether the feature is active, call 611 to add it.

rows.q: how do I report a spam number
rows.answer: You can report a spam number by texting STOP to 7726. You can also block the number directly in your phone’s call log or contacts app. If you want extra protection, enable the free Call Shield service in MyTelecom > Security.
